blocks.title: Local Setup and Backpressure
blocks.code:
cd .smithers && bun install && cd ..
scripts/smthrs ci //.smithers:factory-check //.smithers:wiki-check //.smithers:factory-test
zig build && zig build test
pnpm --filter @tevm/voltaire run test:run
node scripts/audit-report.mjs

cards.label: BYOA MCP
cards.title: Connect Your Agent Over Cloud MCP
cards.text: Attach Claude Code, Codex, or Antigravity to smithers.sh/evmts/voltaire/mcp to read issues, draft TODOs, and inspect flows.

cards.label: Trust Model
cards.title: Run Untrusted Checks Freely
cards.text: External contributors are encouraged to run CI and Uphill audits. Untrusted runs read build.smithers.sh cache but never write to it.

cards.label: Backpressure
cards.title: Pass the Lighthouse Audit Report
cards.text: Every change is scored across Footprint, Zig and Rust Safety, TypeScript Quality, Architecture, and Factory Supply Chain.

cards.label: Post-Merge
cards.title: Land on Smithers Cloud
cards.text: A human maintainer approves and merges. Mirroring to GitHub automatically triggers npm releases, Mintlify docs, and playground deploys.

blocks.title: Voltaire
blocks.tagline: High-performance Ethereum primitives and cryptography built in Zig and TypeScript, with a C99 ABI for any language.
blocks.text: Core Ethereum primitives, audited native cryptography (blst, c-kzg-4844, arkworks), Pure TS, WASM, Bun Native FFI, and C FFI recipes for C, Rust, Go, Python, and Swift.
